description: This file contains unit tests for the OptionalType class in the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It uses the Google Test framework to verify behavior such as default construction, copying, assignment, comparison, and value retrieval of OptionalType objects.

classes.name: OptionalType<T>
classes.description: A template class representing an optional value that may or may not be set.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the value held by the OptionalType instance, marking it as 'not set'.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Returns true if the OptionalType contains a value, false otherwise.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the contained value. Should be called only if IsSet() returns true.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator to set the value of OptionalType.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two OptionalType instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two OptionalType instances.
